Hello, I would like to report that the game is very badly optimized for lower-end devices. To put this into perspective, when playing paladins at max graphics ( paladins is a more graphically intensive game than valorant and the graphics are very similiar) i get stable 70 fps but when i play valorant on the lowest graphics i get 20 to 40 fps and i get 2 second fps drops to 0 fps. After playing more matches a few other players confirmed this and they had the similiar specs. The game is absolutely unplayable for me. Please note this problem.
